convert_script = '''import sys
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
from docx import Document

input_path = "/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx"
output_path = "/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf"

# Read the DOCX content
doc = Document(input_path)

# Build PDF using PyMuPDF
pdf = fitz.open()

# Collect all text from paragraphs
full_text = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    if para.text.strip():
        full_text.append(para.text)

# Also collect table content
for table in doc.tables:
    for row in table.rows:
        row_text = " | ".join(cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells)
        if row_text.strip():
            full_text.append(row_text)

# Create PDF pages with text
fontsize = 11
margin = 72  # 1 inch
page_width = 595  # A4
page_height = 842
text_width = page_width - 2 * margin
line_height = fontsize * 1.4

y = margin
page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)

for line in full_text:
    # Wrap long lines
    words = line.split()
    current_line = ""
    for word in words:
        test_line = current_line + (" " if current_line else "") + word
        # Approximate: ~7 pixels per character at fontsize 11
        if len(test_line) * 6.5 > text_width:
            if y + line_height > page_height - margin:
                page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
                y = margin
            page.insert_text((margin, y), current_line, fontsize=fontsize)
            y += line_height
            current_line = word
        else:
            current_line = test_line
    if current_line:
        if y + line_height > page_height - margin:
            page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
            y = margin
        page.insert_text((margin, y), current_line, fontsize=fontsize)
        y += line_height
    # Add spacing between paragraphs
    y += line_height * 0.3

pdf.save(output_path)
pdf.close()

import os
print(f"PDF created: {output_path}")
print(f"PDF size: {os.path.getsize(output_path)} bytes")
'''
